conf.description: zos-racf racinit / syslog-leef: generic LEEF:1.0 envelope parser for zSecure Audit's QRadar RACINIT feed. The per-event attribute names are set by zSecure's own field selection, which IBM does not publish (work order fields[] is deliberately empty with fields_omitted explaining why), so this maps only the universal, publicly documented LEEF header structure to ECS and preserves every extension attribute verbatim in a generic namespaced bucket rather than guessing RACF-specific ECS targets.

conf.comment: zos-racf / racinit / syslog-leef. No Elastic integration or Cribl pack normalizes RACF in any encoding. fields_omitted says RACINIT attribute names are set by the site's zSecure QRadar interface and are unpublished, so per the do-not-guess rule this does NOT invent ECS targets for individual attributes. Real structural parsing that IS done: split the LEEF:1.0 banner (Vendor|Product|ProductVersion|EventID, public IBM spec, not RACF-specific) into observer.*/event.action, then tab-split the extension into a generic racf.leef.attrs.<key> bucket (nested JS in `code`, not restricted eval/rename path syntax) so every site-emitted attribute is preserved and queryable. devTime, a standard LEEF key, is best-effort promoted to _time if present; naive-local-time/no-LPAR-offset gap matches the `other` format. Direct route, no guard hop.
